title: Apple Inc. (AAPL) Stake Decreased by Dupont Capital Management Corp

organizations.name: dupont capital management corp dupont capital management corp

text:
Dupont Capital Management Corp reduced its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 9.4% in the second its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission. The firm owned 494,507 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 51,324 shares during the period. Apple comprises 2.2% of Dupont Capital Management Corp’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 2nd biggest position. Dupont Capital Management Corp’s holdings in Apple were worth $91,538,000 as of its most recent filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission.
